vocabulary.definition: a ruler with total power over a country, typically one who has obtained control by force
vocabulary.example: The dictator ruled the country with an iron fist, suppressing any form of dissent.
The king was known for his benevolent rule, where he always prioritized the welfare of his subjects.

vocabulary.definition: a government, especially an authoritarian one
vocabulary.example: The regime imposed strict rules on its citizens, limiting their freedoms.

vocabulary.definition: directing one's hopes or ambitions towards becoming a specified type of person
vocabulary.example: She was an aspiring artist, spending hours practicing her craft every day.

vocabulary.definition: suppressing or deleting anything considered objectionable
vocabulary.example: The government was accused of censoring the media to control the narrative.

vocabulary.definition: an irrational suspicion or mistrust of others
vocabulary.example: His paranoia led him to believe that everyone was plotting against him.
